caption: The drawing depicts a single, sleeveless vest viewed from the front, shown open with no buttons fastened. The vest has a light beige or cream color, with subtle brown and tan shading used to illustrate the folds, seams, and areas of shadow, giving it a slightly worn appearance. The fabric's texture and contours are suggested with fine, brownish lines. The vest features a notched collar, two vertical slit pockets on each side at the lower front, and a set of three buttonholes along the right side's front edge, opposite three buttons on the left. The vest also includes two fabric straps, one on each side at the hemline, which hang loosely. The background of the drawing is a plain, light cream color. There is some handwritten text in the upper left and lower right corners of the drawing.
title: Wedding Vest
